LESSON: WRITING 6.3.1 RECORDING SKILLS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Writing 6.3.1 Recording skills
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 6.3.1 Recording skills, part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: What do we wear on a rainy day?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 6.3.1 Recording skills together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and Imagination: communication and self expression skill as learner records the weather chart on a daily

basis.

● Self-efficacy: as learner displays the recorded weather chart for others to view and peer assess.

Values:
● Unity: Cooperation as learner works collaboratively with others to record the weather chart.

● Responsibility:self drive as learner records the weather chart.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Social cohesion as learner interacts with others in observing and recording observed weather.

Link to other Activity Areas:

Environmental Activities as the learner observes and records daily weather.

Suggested Learning Resources: Adapted course books, signed audio visual clips, books, Flash cards, charts, pictures,
